result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: CGL USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M for the applicable data-processing activities, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It leaves the unrelated force majeure language unchanged. However, requiring all coverage for one year after termination exceeds the supplied playbook and is not necessary to reach the stated position; the added “at its own expense” language is also not expressly required, though customary. The insurance clause is otherwise professionally drafted.
